- Implement ecological restoration treatments and adapt them to site response — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Work alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Read site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Map the decision authority and procedural pathway for a proposed action — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Assess species habitat requirements and habitat condition — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Recognize and assess ecosystems that have crossed into novel states — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Administer contracts, grants and intergovernmental agreements — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
